request.query: determinant of AB transpose equals product of determinants over a commutative ring

{

      "formal_name": "Matrix.det_mul",
      "informal_name": "Multiplicativity of the Determinant: $\\det(MN) = \\det(M) \\det(N)$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M N : Matrix n n R),\n  (M * N).det = M.det * N.det",
      "informal_description": "For any $n \\times n$ matrices $M$ and $N$ with entries in a commutative ring $R$, the determinant of their product is equal to the product of their determinants, i.e., $\\det(MN) = \\det(M) \\det(N)$.",

    {

      "informal_name": "Determinant of Matrix Product over Commutative Rings: $\\det(MN) = \\det(NM)$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M N : Matrix m m R),\n  (M * N).det = (N * M).det",
      "informal_description": "For any $n \\times n$ matrices $M$ and $N$ over a commutative ring $R$, the determinant of their product $MN$ is equal to the determinant of their product $NM$.",

      "informal_name": "Commutativity of Determinant for Matrix Products",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {A : Type u_5} [inst : CommRing A] {n : Type u_7} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] (M N : Matrix n n A),\n  (M * N).det = (N * M).det",
      "informal_description": "For any two $ n \\times n $ matrices $ M $ and $ N $ with entries in a commutative ring $ R $, the determinant of their product $ MN $ equals the determinant of $ NM $, i.e., $ \\det(MN) = \\det(NM) $.",

items.informal_description: For any $n \times n$ matrices $M$ and $N$ with entries in a commutative ring $R$, the determinant of their product is equal to the product of their determinants, i.e., $\det(MN) = \det(M) \det(N)$.

items.informal_description: For any $n \times n$ matrices $M$ and $N$ over a commutative ring $R$, the determinant of their product $MN$ is equal to the determinant of their product $NM$.

items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_5} [inst : CommRing A] {n : Type u_7} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] (M N : Matrix n n A),

items.informal_description: For any two $ n \times n $ matrices $ M $ and $ N $ with entries in a commutative ring $ R $, the determinant of their product $ MN $ equals the determinant of $ NM $, i.e., $ \det(MN) = \det(NM) $.

items.informal_name: Determinant of $MN$ Equals Determinant of $NM$ for Invertible $M$
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_5} [inst : CommRing A] {m : Type u_6} {n : Type u_7} [inst_1 : Fintype m] [inst_2 : Fintype n]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq m] [inst_4 : DecidableEq n] {M : Matrix n m A} {N M' : Matrix m n A},
  M * M' = 1 → M' * M = 1 → (M * N).det = (N * M).det
items.informal_description: If $M$ and $M'$ are inverse matrices (i.e., $MM' = I$ and $M'M = I$), then for any square matrix $N$ of the same size, the determinant of the product $MN$ is equal to the determinant of the product $NM$.

items.informal_name: Determinant Equality for AB + I and BA + I
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {α : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype m] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq n] [inst_4 : CommRing α] (A : Matrix m n α) (B : Matrix n m α),
  (A * B + 1).det = (B * A + 1).det
items.informal_description: For matrices $A$ of size $m \times n$ and $B$ of size $n \times m$ over a commutative ring $R$, the determinant of the matrix product $AB + I_m$ (where $I_m$ is the $m \times m$ identity matrix) equals the determinant of $BA + I_n$ (where $I_n$ is the $n \times n$ identity matrix).
